title: Weather and Undertow
author: Lena Nystrom
blurb: Bram Hartwell, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
